title: Bitdeer AI Revenue Backlog Hits $2.9B in September

tickers.name: Bitdeer Technologies Group Class A Ordinary Shares

summary:
The cryptocurrency mining firm produced 1,355 bitcoin in September, marking a 200% increase from the previous year. Bitdeer's self-mining hashrate climbed to 82.3 EH/s from 35 EH/s a year earlier, and co-mining added another 28.7 EH/s to the company's total capacity.

The firm also reported that its AI cloud revenue backlog grew to $2.9 billion from $900 million, including $1.7 billion in expected revenue over five years from its 333.5 MW A201 data center in Malaysia. Despite the output growth, Bitdeer's bitcoin holdings fell to 47 BTC from 2,029 BTC over the last year, and shares fell 1.6% in premarket trading.
